description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'AbstractWidgetData' used as a base data model for widget-related data in the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It includes fields for id, accountId, and themeMode, with associated getters, setters, and overridden equals and hashCode methods.

classes.name: AbstractWidgetData
classes.description: An abstract class representing widget data with fields for id, accountId, and themeMode, including constructors, accessors, mutators, and overridden equality methods.

methods.name: AbstractWidgetData
methods.description: Parameterized constructor initializing id, accountId, and themeMode.

methods.name: getAccountId
methods.description: Returns the account ID associated with the widget.

methods.name: setAccountId
methods.description: Sets the account ID associated with the widget.

methods.name: getThemeMode
methods.description: Returns the theme mode of the widget.

methods.name: setThemeMode
methods.description: Sets the theme mode of the widget.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare widget data objects.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode for widget data objects.
